title: Santa Claus Is Comin' to Town
writers: J. Fred Coots (music) and Haven Gillespie (lyrics)

evidence.note: Written by Coots and Gillespie and published in 1934 by Leo Feist, Inc.

famous_use: The Crystals' 1963 recording, produced by Phil Spector for 'A Christmas Gift for You from Phil Spector', whose refrain was later covered by the Jackson 5, Bruce Springsteen and Mariah Carey.
